parole.testo: Ultimately from Proto-Mongolic *bödene, via a Turkic source. Compare Kazakh бөдене (bödene), Tatar бүдәнә (büdänä), Uyghur بودۇنە (bodune), Uzbek bedana, boʻdana, Turkmen bedene. Largely displaced Classical Persian وَرْتِیج (wartīj) in the eastern dialects of Persian, while the Turkic borrowing بلدر

Ultimately from Proto-Mongolic *girgaxul, via a Turkic source. Compare Azerbaijani qırqovul, Chagatai قرغاول (qirǧawul), Uyghur قىرغۇل (qirghul), Uzbek qirgʻovul, Kazakh қырғауыл (qırğawıl), Kyrgyz кыргоол (kırgool), Tatar кыргавыл (qırğawıl), Bashkir ҡырғауыл (qırğawıl).
